voxelprobe.welcome.title: VoxelProbe
voxelprobe.welcome.description: Connect local tools to inspect your Minecraft world. Inspection starts in read-only mode.
voxelprobe.welcome.permissions: You can enable editing later with /voxelprobe permissions edit, or trusted scripts with /voxelprobe permissions script. Use /voxelprobe for status.
voxelprobe.command.pair: [VoxelProbe] Have your companion tool read this instance's config/debugbridge-connection.json to pair locally.
voxelprobe.command.help: [VoxelProbe] /voxelprobe status | pair | permissions read|edit|script. Read inspects; edit allows world changes and commands; script also enables trusted scripts.
voxelprobe.command.disabled: VoxelProbe is disabled. Choose Start inspection on the welcome screen before changing permissions.
voxelprobe.command.script_trust: [VoxelProbe] Script mode grants full JVM access, including reading and writing files on your computer. Only connect tools you trust.
